title: Carbon Allotrope Forge
description: The user operates a high-temperature carbon allotrope forge. A PotOfCoals serves as the thermal reactor where raw CarbonFibre feedstock is heated, pressurized, and chemically transformed into different carbon allotropes (graphite, diamond, fullerene, graphene, nanotube). The user must manage temperature, pressure, and catalyst inputs while obeying conservation of carbon atoms, with full undo/redo support.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) implementing a Carbon Allotrope Forge. Load PotOfCoals.glb centered at origin as the reactor vessel and CarbonFibre.glb positioned above-left as the carbon feedstock source. Use PerspectiveCamera at (0,3,5) with OrbitControls. Add warm orange PointLight inside the pot, white DirectionalLight from above, and soft AmbientLight.

Interaction system (10-14 steps with multi-input coupling):
1. FEED: Click CarbonFibre to drag carbon units (small dark spheres) into the pot. Each click adds 6 carbon atoms. Track total carbon atom count in a HUD overlay.
2. TEMPERATURE SLIDER: Vertical slider (500K-5000K) on the left. Pot coals glow color shifts from dark red to white-hot based on temperature. Animate emissive color on pot mesh.
3. PRESSURE SLIDER: Vertical slider (1-100 GPa) on the right.
4. CATALYST DROPDOWN: Select from None, Iron, Nickel, Boron. Each catalyst modifies transformation thresholds.
5. TRANSFORM BUTTON: When clicked, evaluate temperature+pressure+catalyst combination to determine which allotrope forms. Rules: Graphite(<2000K,<5GPa), Diamond(>2500K,>50GPa), Fullerene(2000-3000K,10-30GPa,Iron), Graphene(>1500K,<10GPa,Nickel), Nanotube(>1800K,15-40GPa,Boron). Invalid combos show warning.
6. CONSERVATION LAW: Output allotrope consumes exactly the carbon atoms fed. Display input vs output atom count. User cannot transform if fewer than 6 atoms are loaded.
7. Successful transforms spawn a labeled 3D object orbiting the pot (icosahedron=fullerene, flat plane=graphene, cylinder=nanotube, octahedron=diamond, layered box=graphite) with distinct colors.
8. UNDO/REDO: Buttons that revert or replay any action (feed, slider change, transform). Maintain a full action history stack.
9. HUD shows: Carbon atoms in reactor, temperature, pressure, catalyst, list of produced allotropes with atom counts, and a conservation checksum (total atoms in = total atoms out + atoms remaining).
10. Add particle effects inside pot that intensify with temperature. CarbonFibre model should visually shrink as atoms are consumed from it.
